Hi Samir / Novaprod team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the initial rollout. To get the engagement started we want to lock a 90-minute Project Starter (kickoff) where we cover objectives, roles, success criteria, and the first two sprint milestones.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Oct 26 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Oct 27 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Oct 28 — 13:00–14:30 PT

Could you confirm which slot works for your core team and provide the attendee list (name + role + timezone) — we usually ask for: Product sponsor, Technical lead, Security contact, and an Ops/Infra contact. I’ve attached a starter agenda and a simple roster CSV for you to fill in.

Draft agenda (attached as starter-agenda.pdf):
1) Intros & goals (10m)
2) Scope & timeline (20m)
3) Technical onboarding (30m)
4) Integration checklist & access (20m)
5) Next steps / owners (10m)

Internal owners: Marissa will own go-live coordination; Ben will lead the integration walkthrough. If Monica can lead the access & infra items, that would help shorten follow-up tickets.

Samir — if we get names today/tomorrow we’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom and the meeting pack.

Thanks,

Ava Chen

+1 415‑555‑0124
